protocol: Exact same analytic three-determinant pi/0-flux singlet/A1 carrier and complete 432-image projection, all 216 H bonds. Independently train additive110, unrestricted360 and all730 shared attention parameters from identical G=0 physical state. Fixed positive-Q carrier+uniform floor with H-exchange bridge; train and untouched audit chains have different seeds. No ED, frozen backbone, carrier replacement, post-outcome extension or best-checkpoint selection.
optimizer: 60 fixed full-gradient Adam-direction steps, beta1=.9 beta2=.999 eps=1e-8. Normalize only direction length, then 12 fixed amplitude evaluations match empirical dev FS radius .002, never select by energy. Different physical update distances are reported rather than asserted equal. Different parameter counts are intentional expressive controls.
objective: Real full-H fixed-Q self-normalized Rayleigh ratio per site. Differentiate BOTH bra and ket/Hpsi, not a diagonal proxy or an asymptotic VMC force. Exact fixed-carrier1176 features include every H/group term and are shared across arms; report construction cost separately from cached objective contractions. No claim that finite-Q training energies are variational bounds.
audit: Generate128 new records on16 independent chains ONLY after all fixed60-step endpoints are sealed. Include unmodified carrier; use node-safe totalH moments and paired whole-chain bootstrap, jackknife, LOCO, normESS and H-residual concentration. Primary full360-minus-additive110 energy; variance and NN are also reported. Confidence intervals do not certify equilibrium or unseen tails. Do not call bounded null fully optimized unless convergence supports it; no automatic extra sampling if unresolved.
